jobs.title: Field Operations Lead - Arabian Gulf
jobs.description:
About Quartermaster

Quartermaster is a U.S. maritime technology company. We put safety and connectivity systems aboard commercial vessels and deliver the resulting maritime situational awareness data as a commercial service. We are scaling across the Arabian Gulf and hiring a regional lead to drive it.

The Job

Close fleet-scale agreements with vessel operators across the Gulf, and move our regulatory approvals faster than they would move without you. You will be Quartermaster's senior regional representative across the Arabian Gulf, reporting directly to leadership in the United States.

What You'll Own

 - Fleet growth: Open and close agreements with vessel owners and operators across the region to get our equipment installed at scale.

 - Execution: Manage multi-country operations end to end — installations, field team, logistics, and the local partners who make it happen across each market.

 - Regulators: Support our engagement with maritime and ports authorities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, and Oman — clearing approvals and answering the concerns that would otherwise stall installs.

What You Need

 - Based in the Gulf region, ready to travel extensively across the GCC.

 - Senior standing in the Gulf's domestic maritime industry, with direct working relationships among vessel owners and operators across multiple countries — fleet owners know you, take your call, and will hear you out.

 - A closer. You find the way around obstacles, work through owner objections, and carry commercial agreements from first meeting to signature.

 - Working familiarity with maritime regulatory environments across the Gulf states, and the credibility to navigate them on our behalf.

 - Fluent English and Arabic.

Nice to Have

 - Additional regional languages (Urdu, Hindi, Tagalog, Farsi) reflecting the multinational maritime workforce in the Gulf.

 - Relationships across the region's maritime regulatory bodies — UAE Federal Transport Authority (FTA), Dubai Maritime Authority, Abu Dhabi Maritime, Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani), Saudi Transport General Authority (TGA), Qatar Ministry of Transport / Mwani Qatar, Bahrain Ministry of Transportation and Telecommunications, Kuwait Ports Authority, and Oman's ASYAD Group / Ministry of Transport. Experience carrying vessels through any of these processes is a real asset.

 - Standing in regional industry bodies (e.g., national shipowners' associations, GCC maritime committees).

jobs.title: Associate Human Resources Generalist
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

 Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.




JOB DESCRIPTION

 Quartermaster is seeking a proactive, highly organized Associate HR Generalist to support our rapidly scaling team and help build out our core People operations. In this role, you will work across the entire employee lifecycle—driving seamless onboarding, managing day-to-day HR administrative operations, maintaining HRIS systems, and supporting employee relations, benefits, and compliance initiatives.

You will serve as a primary point of contact for employee inquiries, ensuring our team members experience high-touch, reliable support as we scale. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced startup environments, brings meticulous attention to detail, and excels at building scalable HR processes without sacrificing the personal touch that makes a great workplace culture.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the end-to-end employee onboarding and offboarding processes, coordinating with IT, Recruiting, and hiring managers to deliver a seamless team member experience.

 - Maintain data integrity and manage records within our HRIS, keeping employee profiles, organizational charts, and compensation tracking accurate and up-to-date.

 - Serve as the first point of contact for employee inquiries regarding benefits, HR policies, leave requests, and general HR processes.

 - Assist in administering company benefits programs, including open enrollment, broker coordination, leave of absence management, and worker's compensation.

 - Support compliance initiatives by monitoring federal, state, and local labor law requirements, updating employee handbooks, and managing personnel files.

 - Coordinate performance management cycles, employee feedback touchpoints, and training initiatives across cross-functional teams.

 - Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to streamline the transition from candidate offer acceptance to Day 1 onboarding.

 - Drive culture initiatives, employee recognition programs, team events, and office experience projects to maintain high team engagement.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

 - 1–3 years of hands-on HR experience (as an HR Assistant, Coordinator, or Junior Generalist), preferably in a venture-backed tech startup, engineering, or fast-growing environment.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Hands-on experience with modern HR platforms (e.g., Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, Sequoia, or similar HRIS tools).

 - Solid understanding of HR fundamentals, labor laws, benefits administration, and compliance best practices.

 - High degree of discretion, maturity, and judgment when handling sensitive, confidential information.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-service mindset toward supporting team members.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask, prioritize, and drive projects independently in a fast-changing environment.

 - Bonus: HR certification (SHRM-CP or PHR) or prior experience supporting distributed/hybrid engineering teams.
   
   


WORK ENVIRONMENT

 - Hybrid environment with regular time at our Arlington, VA office.

 - High-velocity startup atmosphere with high autonomy and opportunities for rapid career growth.

 - Flexible working hours with occasional deadline-driven projects.
